preimages/truncated-record: past the end of the file
preimages/raw-address-order: preimage record 1 is out of hashed-key order
preimages/raw-slot-order: slot keys are out of hashed-key order
preimages/duplicate-address: preimage record 2 is out of hashed-key order
preimages/duplicate-slot: record \d+ slot keys are out of hashed-key order
preimages/surplus-account: names address .* which the state does not hold
preimages/missing-header-slot: holds slot 63, which the preimage file does not name
preimages/surplus-header-slot: names slot 7 of .* which the state does not hold
snapshot/wrong-claimed-root: leaves rebuild to .* its header claims
snapshot/leaf-count-low: holds more records than the 354 its header claims
snapshot/flipped-value: re-derive merkle root .* the anchor commits
snapshot/basic-data-reserved-garbage: basic-data leaf is not the canonical encoding
snapshot/orphan-code-leaves: addressed by no account's code hash
snapshot/delegation-and-code-hash: holds both a code-hash and a delegation leaf
snapshot/delegation-leaf-missing: holds neither a code-hash nor a delegation leaf
snapshot/codeless-without-code-hash: holds neither a code-hash nor a delegation leaf
snapshot/delegation-with-code-leaves: addressed by no account's code hash
snapshot/delegation-wrong-code-size: delegation with code size 24, must be 23
snapshot/delegation-code-size-zero: delegation with code size 0, must be 23
snapshot/delegation-padding-garbage: delegation leaf is not the canonical encoding
snapshot/header-slot-in-storage-zone: names slot 0 of .* which the state does not hold
snapshot/anchored-elsewhere: re-derive merkle root .* the anchor commits
